description:
## [2.8.0](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/compare/v2.7.1...v2.8.0) (2026-11-26)

### Features

* Export patches from the source card and confirm renames ([0f23abd](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/0f23abd51bfe003798d2695bb65c37c250b3dcd6))
* Fall back to the Morphe API for manager updates ([afd5ecb](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/afd5ecbec594d7afe795ac67edb665c20a4dd503))
* Install patched apps compiled with their baseline profile ([#1523](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/issues/1523)) ([e436a28](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/e436a28b8f70664baa639d3d91e669c6aa4e6ec9))
* Keep a mini-game round paused for the next visit ([28f11d0](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/28f11d0757e406c5a51cbf58ee17307e19d6078a))
* Open the mini-games from the patching screen ([ce51c04](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/ce51c04ef81e7fd71231bad2d4e628afcafda8a4))
* Show how the last processes ended in the debug log ([9a7059c](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/9a7059ce1700309663a64636453311aaabec9cc6))
* Show what's new for queued apps in batch patching ([adde0f2](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/adde0f2b0e4a3bff07edaac50e7a8189b2174929))
* Show whether the app runs as 32 or 64 bit in the debug log ([3ef62b7](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/3ef62b744a786c21809b990af271a68f2c0bc56c))
* Support patch sources hosted on Codeberg ([1bfb971](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/1bfb9714ab1b6724b1555304414f9b0de7ba6f53))
* Tell sources that failed to download apart from missing metadata ([3d01459](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/3d014593b86203894c6bfbb0635b0204f45d9217))
* Update Morphe silently with root or Shizuku and reopen it afterwards ([e048230](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/e0482302d6a42ac2e3f16b08d7189694233fa8eb))
* Wait for the network instead of restarting interrupted downloads ([357a9f6](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/357a9f654d02ad394499d4adce900e4be2732c61))

### Performance Improvements

* Faster app startup on Android 15+ ([#1524](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/issues/1524)) ([34c297f](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/34c297f58dd14727cb3e3f98c81c9972daa8be39))

### Bug Fixes

* Auto-install a finished run while the mini-games are open ([ac33474](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/ac334744fbc2f2cab3fc2e3b82d46e45d002d770))
* Carry on with a paused mini-game round when it is picked again ([831a69a](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/831a69ab71d23078441eb34b943bba32d8aebcb6))
* Finish changing an app's web links after the page closes ([5324705](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/53247054caa30cce0601729318fd97a1c88ee7a3))
* Finish deleting and uninstalling saved APKs after the list closes ([31b1992](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/31b1992db48751c825fea2b2e9130d8c2bd4d04f))
* Finish saving source choices after their dialog closes ([2c2ce2e](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/2c2ce2edf39f66a39de40a57781b302e8ad33100))
* Improve patching speed for budget devices with 32-bit roms or less than 8 cores ([#1516](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/issues/1516)) ([2affc52](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/2affc52cca07c7ee22e9b7b4cb672491e9975bc3))
* Include the manager's logs in the debug log on Android 10 and older ([47c7618](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/47c761848e50cb3a94702975c0d2bdc3a9c4be48))
* Keep an install queue going while other screens are open ([75b559d](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/75b559d137a2a0ccb1ef4904ce442f299e55e2ed))
* Keep animated backgrounds seamless and density independent ([072083d](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/072083d0e05b137a3cb7c68b5a0fc33c5ddfc450))
* Keep download progress rings level with their percentage ([b28da13](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/b28da13531af0fc19f3c97aa49bc2f2e874b046d))
* Keep the mesh background edge out of view after rotation ([f93e5ee](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/f93e5eeb67ceabf6077b4c57dd6f238403ded5d0))
* Keep the patcher heap within 40% of RAM on devices under 5 GB ([6e4d289](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/6e4d28929c230fe520c3c393db59635eec3e890b))
* Mirror version changes and layout direction in RTL languages ([cee8e3e](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/cee8e3eb912a0cd3681fe92fb273e443571ea4cb))
* Offer Shizuku access on the web links screen when it is missing ([84aa158](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/84aa158579b2cd980b71f9b1abf93e96ad79f2e1))
* Take down the patching notification left by a killed run ([028365a](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/028365a297334e4787d85d7a60962ea9a4515a33))
* Tell the user when patching was cut short by the app closing ([25d8fb0](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/25d8fb0f3572eda28a2da3cc365a3b41f0abe756))
* Update root modules on kernels that refuse to rename mounted files ([2d673bb](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager/commit/2d673bb8f5836966634655ac243c4523023e85b6))
